content: <thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 141.1154, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral exact mass of ≈140.1081 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass, consistent with the observed isotopic pattern (≈7 % M+1 intensity indicating ~7 carbons), is C₇H₁₂N₂O. This fits the required format CxHyOzX (with X representing the heteroatom nitrogen).
